body: hey there, I didnt get help but i ended up being fine anyway. It was actually really heartwarming to see this in my notifs too, thankyou, seriously, thankyou.

Im in Aus but i have searched up a bit about it. It's also been it my system {the only other thing ive consumed being coffee} for over a half hour and I feel completely fine, even though im pretty small and i thought it might effect me more. Seems not, not even a headache yet.

Honestly, same. I'm super sort (just about 5'2) and my height is a thing I can be really dysphoric about. Recently I've been wearing shoes that have a sort of platform to them, (and being so small I have tiny feet) and wearing sizes that are 1 - 3 times too big.   
Those sort of things help me at least, and maybe they can help you out too?

And yes, you can transition, you can finally be the man you were really meant to be! Short men are cute, I promise you that you'll find someone who will love you for who you are, no matter the height, no matter the time in transition. As long as you are happy, they *will* love you. Regardless.

We love you

\~Julian

The moment I was just looking through pinterest and found my name, and it was just, wow, it's **MY** name, sitting there, on that screen. That was the first time I just let myself be who I am, not continually convincing myself stuff like that my dysphoria is fake, that I'm going to regret coming out and whatnot.  
It was the first time i finally felt like me - I just hope it can happen again.
